events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: An exclusive exhibition at GOMA featuring major installations, sculptures, and photo series by Olafur Eliasson, exploring light, perception, science, and the environment. It invites visitors through shifting immersive environments.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights – Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: An after-hours social event at QAGOMA built around the Olafur Eliasson exhibition, featuring Brisbane DJs, pop-up performances, bespoke bars, and food. A chance to experience art in a lively atmosphere.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: Showcasing outstanding photojournalism and documentary photography from around the world, this free exhibition features winning images selected from over 57,000 entries, recognising courageous visual storytelling.

events.title: Make A Scene – Free Exhibition at Queensland Museum
events.description: A free exhibition at Queensland Museum showcasing Australian queer culture from the 90s, featuring fashion, pop culture, and personal stories from the underground nightclub and dance party scene, marking 35 years of decriminalisation.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical
events.description: Based on Tim Burton's film, this musical tells the story of Lydia Deetz, a strange teenager who encounters a deceased couple and a demon, featuring an irreverent book, astonishing set, and acclaimed score.

events.title: Macbeth – Shake & Stir Theatre Co
events.description: Shake & Stir Theatre Co presents a contemporary adaptation of Shakespeare's Macbeth, starring Jeremiah Wray and Nelle Lee. This production tackles the gripping tragedy with their signature style, celebrating their 20th anniversary.

events.title: GRIMM: Tales from the Brothers Grimm
events.description: A smash-hit, darkly playful theatre production that reimagines classic Brothers Grimm fairy tales, returning to QPAC's Cremorne Theatre for a twisted, sold-out run.

events.title: Dax Savage: Last Man on Earth
events.description: An exciting independent queer theatre production from Fake Blood at Pip Theatre, set post-apocalypse, questioning human evolution and societal collapse. Features a stellar local cast.

events.title: Lose to Win
events.description: Actor Mandela Mathia recounts his true refugee journey from South Sudan to performing on Australian stages, brought to Brisbane by Belvoir St Theatre as the final stop on its 2026 tour.

events.title: Ella Mai – Live at Fortitude Music Hall
events.description: UK R&B singer Ella Mai performs live in Brisbane, known for her soulful voice and hit songs, bringing her acclaimed show to Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Purity Ring – The Tivoli
events.description: Canadian electronic music duo Purity Ring, known for their atmospheric and layered dream-pop sound, perform live at The Tivoli in Fortitude Valley.

events.title: Foxy Shazam and Big Red Fire Truck – The Triffid
events.description: A lively double bill featuring Foxy Shazam and Big Red Fire Truck, performing at The Triffid, one of Brisbane's popular mid-size music venues.

events.title: Leon Thomas – Fortitude Music Hall
events.description: American R&B singer and songwriter Leon Thomas performs his acclaimed solo work live at Fortitude Music Hall, known for his unique sound and contributions to popular music.

events.title: Descendents – The Tivoli
events.description: Punk rock legends Descendents bring their iconic, high-energy live show to The Tivoli for one night only, promising a memorable experience for fans.

events.title: Donny Benet – The Triffid
events.description: Australia's 'King of Soft Rock', Donny Benet, brings his smooth, sophisticated disco-funk and lounge music to The Triffid, a beloved boutique music venue.

events.title: The Jungle Giants
events.description: Brisbane's indie-dance outfit The Jungle Giants play a hometown headline show at Fortitude Music Hall, supported by exciting up-and-coming acts The Tullamarines and Tear Drive.

events.title: Josh Pyke – The Triffid
events.description: Acclaimed Australian singer-songwriter Josh Pyke brings his introspective folk-pop to The Triffid, offering an intimate live music experience in one of Brisbane's favourite venues.

events.title: Jazz Club Thursdays at Mr. Vain
events.description: A recurring weekly jazz club night at Mr. Vain, offering live jazz music in a relaxed dining setting. Enjoy an evening of authentic, atmospheric music.
